en_title: 'Jaws Hit the Floor' at Auction House as Retired Decorator Sells Pokémon Cards for $2 Million
cn_title: 退休装修工拍卖《宝可梦》卡致富
subtitle: 阁楼里真有宝藏
opus_summary: 英国一名退休装修工拍卖阁楼中收藏多年的《宝可梦》卡牌，成为百万富翁。这批藏品保存完好、成套且未经使用，吸引全球买家竞拍，创下拍卖行开业逾３０年来最成功的拍卖纪录。

paragraphs.en: A retired decorator from the UK just became a millionaire by selling a bunch of Pokémon cards collecting dust in his loft for $2 million.
paragraphs.cn: 英国一名退休装修工以200万美元(约合人民币1336万元)卖掉了阁楼里积灰的一批《宝可梦》卡牌，一举成为百万富翁。

paragraphs.en: The man, from Woking, UK, said he had no idea the cards were valuable until he read about a single card fetching £6,000 (approx. $8,000).
paragraphs.cn: 这名来自英国沃金的男子说，直到读到一张卡牌卖出6,000英镑(约合人民币5万元)、约合8,000美元(约合人民币5万元)的消息，他才知道这些卡牌很值钱。

paragraphs.en: The cards were auctioned off at Surrey-based auction house Ewbank's on Wednesday for £1.56 million (approx. $2 million). "I know people always talk about finding treasure in the attic, but in my case that is literally true," said the anonymous retiree, via the BBC .
paragraphs.cn: 周三，这批卡牌在萨里郡的Ewbank's拍卖行以156万英镑(约合人民币1396万元)成交，约合200万美元(约合人民币1336万元)。据BBC报道，这名不愿透露姓名的退休男子说：「我知道大家总说能在阁楼里找到宝藏，但对我来说，这还真是字面意义上的事实。」

paragraphs.en: "When my son was young, in the late 1990s, he started getting cards and swapping them at school. I thought they looked nice and wondered whether they might be a good investment. He had his own cards, but he never got to touch these, I'm glad to say."
paragraphs.cn: 「20世纪90年代末，我儿子还小，开始收集卡牌，在学校里和别人交换。我觉得这些卡牌很好看，就想它们会不会值得投资。他有自己的卡牌，不过让我庆幸的是，我收藏的这些，他从来没碰过。」

paragraphs.en: He stored the cards away after his son lost interest in collecting them all. One set, which the newly minted millionaire bought from a Malaysian eBay seller for £300 (approx. $400), went for a whopping £75,000 (approx. $100,000) at auction.
paragraphs.cn: 儿子不再热衷于集齐卡牌后，他便将这些卡牌收了起来。这位新晋百万富翁曾花300英镑(约合人民币2685元)，约合400美元(约合人民币2672元)，从一名马来西亚eBay卖家手中购入一套卡牌。如今，这套卡牌在拍卖会上竟卖出了75,000英镑(约合人民币67万元)，约合10万美元(约合人民币67万元)。

paragraphs.en: An auction official said "jaws hit the floor" when the man showed them his collection. "When we saw what he had — all in mint condition — we couldn't believe it," said head of trading cards at Ewbank’s, James Spooner.
paragraphs.cn: 一名拍卖行工作人员说，这名男子向他们展示藏品时，大家都「惊掉了下巴」。Ewbank's集换式卡牌业务负责人James Spooner说：「看到他的藏品，而且全都品相完美时，我们简直不敢相信。」

paragraphs.en: It was the most successful sale Ewbank’s has seen in over 30 years of business. The Legendary Collection Complete Master Set alone went for £100,000 (approx. $133,000).
paragraphs.cn: 这是Ewbank's开业30多年来最成功的一场拍卖。仅Legendary Collection全套卡牌就拍出了10万英镑(约合人民币89万元)，约合13.3万美元(约合人民币89万元)。

paragraphs.en: Ewbank conducted the sale himself. When it went through, he told bidders he was "going for a lie down.” There was global buzz for the auction leading up to the day, and bidders phoned in from all over the world. Interest was particularly high because the entire collection was pristine, complete, and untouched — stuffed with every rarity of card you could imagine.
paragraphs.cn: Ewbank亲自主持了这场拍卖。拍卖完成后，他告诉竞拍者，自己「得去躺一会儿」。拍卖开始前，全球各地就已热议此事，竞拍者从世界各地打来电话参与竞价。这批藏品品相完美、成套且未经使用，囊括了能想到的所有稀有度的卡牌，因此格外受关注。

paragraphs.en: In April this year, teacher Andrew Braund approached Ewbank’s with a 20-year-old collection of Pokémon cards he had kept in his parents’ attic. He consigned the three rarest cards to Ewbank’s who took £32,800 for them on April 16, with Andrew using the proceeds to pay for his August wedding .
paragraphs.cn: 今年4月，教师Andrew Braund带着一批收藏了20年的《宝可梦》卡牌找到Ewbank's。这些卡牌此前一直存放在他父母家的阁楼里。他将其中最稀有的三张委托给Ewbank's拍卖，最终于4月16日卖出32,800英镑(约合人民币29万元)。Andrew用这笔收入支付了自己8月婚礼的费用。

paragraphs.en: These cards have some way to go before coming close to the most expensive Pokémon card ever sold, however. In February, the Pikachu Illustrator card sold for an eye-watering $16,492,000 after 41 days of bidding. It belonged to American influencer and wrestler Logan Paul, who bought it for $5.275 million in July 2021.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这些卡牌的成交价距离《宝可梦》卡牌的最高成交纪录还差得很远。今年2月，经过41天竞价，一张皮卡丘插画家卡以令人咋舌的16,492,000美元(约合人民币1亿元)成交。这张卡此前属于美国网红兼摔角手Logan Paul，他于2021年7月以527.5万美元(约合人民币3524万元)购入。

paragraphs.en: More than 10 billion Pokémon cards were printed last year alone, and 85 billion have been created in total. That volume makes it hard to come across complete sets and the rarest cards, which are so sought after that people pull off Pokémon card heists to steal them.
paragraphs.cn: 仅去年一年，《宝可梦》卡牌的印量就超过100亿张，累计印量则达到850亿张。如此庞大的数量，让人很难凑齐整套卡牌或找到最稀有的卡牌。这些卡牌太过抢手，甚至有人为此实施《宝可梦》卡牌劫案。
